primary_outcome: Qualified inbound enquiries from local Flemish service businesses

work: verify WAT-only GSC and GA4 access, baseline 28d/90d
crawl canonical, redirects, sitemap, robots, page titles and indexability evidence
map actual existing URLs to search intent; establish relevant competitor set
audit mobile contact buttons, consent and measurement, label proxy clicks correctly
Prioritize proven deep problem-to-solution search intents across Dutch-speaking Belgium, not Antwerp-first agency queries
optimize existing pages with genuine service outcomes and proof
prepare distinct high-intent landing page PRs where real gaps demand them
fix navigation to call/WhatsApp/email with accurate tracking
publish approved, differentiated sector experience and project case studies
answer verified buyer questions with sourced specifics and useful internal links
assess local citation/GBP eligibility and authority gaps
track organic enquiry quality, not just visits
check new query/URL CTR and intent alignment
reduce cannibalization and poor-performing funnel steps
reassess validated keyword targets and service-area expansion
prioritize fixes based on actual leads and rank changes

weekly_gap_categories: deep economic business pains: unpredictable pipeline, quote losses, wrong-fit leads, poor return on spend
direct commercial intent and uncovered landing pages
competitor topical/authority differences supported by current sources
information gain and AI-search answerability without AI citation guarantees
internal links, cannibalization and conversion friction
decision_formula: Rank candidate improvements by business intent × opportunity evidence × feasibility × expected lead value, subtract trust/technical risk. Do not manufacture scores where evidence is missing.
publish_policy: Weekly run may audit and open PRs/issues only until explicitly tested and approved. No automatic merging, new URLs, prices, claims or redirects.
minimum_report: WAT data access and evidence availability
Top opportunities and gaps with evidence
Actual actions, PR links and next checkpoint
Selected authentic Claude skills accessible to runner or 'none verified'
Evidence that research problems are real, searched for, and realistically addressable by WAT
